IEEE-754 AArch64 Scalar Floating-Point Semantics

Computable, bit-exact IEEE-754 binary32 (BitVec 32) and binary64 (BitVec 64) scalar floating-point semantics under default FPCR = 0 (FZ = 0, DN = 0, untrapped FPSR exception accumulation, tininess detected before rounding). Defines format-parametric unpacking (FpFormat.unpackFp), dyadic rounding (roundDyadic) across all five FpRoundMode modes, arithmetic, comparison, and conversion operations, and 32/64-bit instruction wrappers.

@[expose] public section
namespace Arm64

inductive FpRoundModeL28–40 ↗#

IEEE-754 / ARMv8-A floating-point rounding modes (FPRounding).

inductive FpRoundMode where /-- Round to Nearest, ties to Even (`RNE`, `rmode = 0b00`). -/ | RNE /-- Round towards Plus Infinity (`RTP`, `rmode = 0b01`). -/ | RTP /-- Round towards Minus Infinity (`RTN`, `rmode = 0b10`). -/ | RTN /-- Round towards Zero (`RTZ`, `rmode = 0b11`). -/ | RTZ /-- Round to Nearest, ties Away from zero (`RNA`, `FRINTA` / `FCVTAS` / `FCVTAU`). -/ | RNA deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def FpRoundMode.ofBits2L42–48 ↗#

Decode a 2-bit architectural rounding mode (00=RNE, 01=RTP, 10=RTN, 11=RTZ).

def FpRoundMode.ofBits2 (rmode : BitVec 2) : FpRoundMode := match rmode.toNat with | 0 => .RNE | 1 => .RTP | 2 => .RTN | _ => .RTZ

structure FpFormatL50–54 ↗#

Format parameters for an IEEE-754 binary floating-point format.

structure FpFormat where expBits : Nat fracBits : Nat deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def fpFormat32L56–57 ↗#

IEEE-754 single-precision (binary32: 8 exponent bits, 23 fraction bits).

def fpFormat32 : FpFormat := { expBits := 8, fracBits := 23 }

def fpFormat64L59–60 ↗#

IEEE-754 double-precision (binary64: 11 exponent bits, 52 fraction bits).

def fpFormat64 : FpFormat := { expBits := 11, fracBits := 52 }

inductive UnpackedFpL62–68 ↗#

Architectural category of an unpacked IEEE-754 operand (FPUnpack with FZ = 0).

inductive UnpackedFp where | nan (signaling : Bool) | inf (sign : Bool) | zero (sign : Bool) | finite (sign : Bool) (sig : Nat) (exp2 : Int) deriving DecidableEq, Repr
namespace FpFormat

def widthL72–73 ↗#

Total bit width (1 + expBits + fracBits).

def width (fmt : FpFormat) : Nat := 1 + fmt.expBits + fmt.fracBits

def maxExpL75–76 ↗#

Maximum biased exponent (2^expBits - 1: 255 for binary32, 2047 for binary64).

def maxExp (fmt : FpFormat) : Nat := (1 <<< fmt.expBits) - 1

def biasL78–79 ↗#

Exponent bias (2^(expBits - 1) - 1: 127 for binary32, 1023 for binary64).

def bias (fmt : FpFormat) : Int := Int.ofNat ((1 <<< (fmt.expBits - 1)) - 1)

def minExp2L81–82 ↗#

Minimum ULP base-2 exponent (1 - bias - fracBits: -149 for binary32, -1074 for binary64).

def minExp2 (fmt : FpFormat) : Int := 1 - fmt.bias - Int.ofNat fmt.fracBits

def maxExp2L84–85 ↗#

Maximum normal ULP base-2 exponent ((maxExp - 1) - bias - fracBits: 104 for binary32, 971 for binary64).

def maxExp2 (fmt : FpFormat) : Int := Int.ofNat (fmt.maxExp - 1) - fmt.bias - Int.ofNat fmt.fracBits

def packNatL87–92 ↗#

Pack (sign, biasedExp, frac) into a raw Nat bit pattern.

def packNat (fmt : FpFormat) (sign : Bool) (biasedExp : Nat) (frac : Nat) : Nat := let s := if sign then (1 <<< (fmt.expBits + fmt.fracBits)) else 0 let e := (biasedExp % (1 <<< fmt.expBits)) <<< fmt.fracBits let m := frac % (1 <<< fmt.fracBits) s ||| e ||| m

def packZeroL94–96 ↗#

Pack signed zero (±0.0).

def packZero (fmt : FpFormat) (sign : Bool) : Nat := fmt.packNat sign 0 0

def packInfL98–100 ↗#

Pack signed infinity (±Inf).

def packInf (fmt : FpFormat) (sign : Bool) : Nat := fmt.packNat sign fmt.maxExp 0

def packMaxFiniteL102–104 ↗#

Pack maximum finite float with given sign (±maxFinite).

def packMaxFinite (fmt : FpFormat) (sign : Bool) : Nat := fmt.packNat sign (fmt.maxExp - 1) ((1 <<< fmt.fracBits) - 1)

def defaultNaNL106–108 ↗#

Architectural default quiet NaN (FPDefaultNaN, DN = 0): 0x7fc00000 or 0x7ff8000000000000.

def defaultNaN (fmt : FpFormat) : Nat := fmt.packNat false fmt.maxExp (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits - 1))

def unpackRawL114–119 ↗#

Extract (sign, biasedExp, frac) from a raw Nat bit pattern.

def unpackRaw (fmt : FpFormat) (raw : Nat) : Bool × Nat × Nat := let sign := ((raw >>> (fmt.expBits + fmt.fracBits)) &&& 1) != 0 let exp := (raw >>> fmt.fracBits) &&& ((1 <<< fmt.expBits) - 1) let frac := raw &&& ((1 <<< fmt.fracBits) - 1) (sign, exp, frac)

def isNaNRawL121–124 ↗#

Check if raw bit pattern is a NaN (exp == maxExp && frac != 0).

def isNaNRaw (fmt : FpFormat) (raw : Nat) : Bool := let (_, exp, frac) := fmt.unpackRaw raw exp == fmt.maxExp && frac != 0

def unpackFiniteL146–152 ↗#

Extract (sign, sig, exp2) for a finite non-zero float such that value is (-1)^sign * sig * 2^exp2.

def unpackFinite (fmt : FpFormat) (raw : Nat) : Bool × Nat × Int := let (sign, exp, frac) := fmt.unpackRaw raw if exp == 0 then (sign, frac, fmt.minExp2) else (sign, (1 <<< fmt.fracBits) ||| frac, Int.ofNat exp - fmt.bias - Int.ofNat fmt.fracBits)

def unpackFpL154–165 ↗#

Unpack a fmt.width-bit IEEE-754 float into its exact architectural category (FPUnpack).

def unpackFp (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : UnpackedFp := let raw := x.toNat let (sign, exp, frac) := fmt.unpackRaw raw if exp == fmt.maxExp then if frac == 0 then .inf sign else .nan (((frac >>> (fmt.fracBits - 1)) &&& 1) == 0) else if exp == 0 && frac == 0 then .zero sign else let (s, sig, exp2) := fmt.unpackFinite raw .finite s sig exp2
end FpFormat

def processNaNs2L169–178 ↗#

ARMv8-A FPProcessNaNs (DN = 0): propagates the first signaling NaN (quieting it and raising fpsrIOC), else the first quiet NaN (with 0#32), or returns none.

def processNaNs2 (fmt : FpFormat) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : Option (BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32) := let quietBit := BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits - 1)) match fmt.unpackFp a, fmt.unpackFp b with | .nan true, _ => some (a ||| quietBit, fpsrIOC) | _, .nan true => some (b ||| quietBit, fpsrIOC) | .nan false, _ => some (a, 0#32) | _, .nan false => some (b, 0#32) | _, _ => none

def fpRoundIncrementL180–187 ↗#

Decide whether to increment a rounded magnitude given sign, rm, isOdd, roundBit, and stickyBit.

def fpRoundIncrement (sign : Bool) (rm : FpRoundMode) (isOdd roundBit stickyBit : Bool) : Bool := match rm with | .RNE => roundBit && (stickyBit || isOdd) | .RNA => roundBit | .RTP => !sign && (roundBit || stickyBit) | .RTN => sign && (roundBit || stickyBit) | .RTZ => false

def rshiftWithRoundStickyL189–199 ↗#

Shift sig right by rshift ≥ 1 bits, returning (quot, roundBit, stickyBit) with stickyIn folded into stickyBit and shifts above maxShift clamped to (0, false, (sig != 0) || stickyIn).

def rshiftWithRoundSticky (maxShift sig rshift : Nat) (stickyIn : Bool) : Nat × Bool × Bool := if rshift > maxShift then (0, false, (sig != 0) || stickyIn) else let q := sig >>> rshift let rBit := ((sig >>> (rshift - 1)) &&& 1) != 0 let sMask := (1 <<< (rshift - 1)) - 1 let sBit := ((sig &&& sMask) != 0) || stickyIn (q, rBit, sBit)

def roundDyadicL201–245 ↗#

Round an exact dyadic magnitude (-1)^sign * (sig + stickyIn) * 2^exp2 to fmt under rm, returning (packedValue, fpsrFlags) per ARMv8-A FPRoundBase (FPCR = 0: untrapped, FZ = 0, tininess detected before rounding).

def roundDyadic (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (sign : Bool) (sig : Nat) (exp2 : Int) (stickyIn : Bool) : Nat × BitVec 32 := if sig == 0 && !stickyIn then (fmt.packZero sign, 0#32) else let bits : Nat := if sig == 0 then 0 else Nat.log2 sig + 1 let targetBits : Nat := fmt.fracBits + 1 let exp2Norm : Int := exp2 + Int.ofNat bits - Int.ofNat targetBits let isTiny : Bool := exp2Norm < fmt.minExp2 let ulpExp2 : Int := if isTiny then fmt.minExp2 else exp2Norm let shift : Int := exp2 - ulpExp2 let (quot, roundBit, stickyBit) : Nat × Bool × Bool := if shift ≥ 0 then (sig <<< shift.toNat, false, stickyIn) else rshiftWithRoundSticky (bits + 1) sig (-shift).toNat stickyIn let inexact : Bool := roundBit || stickyBit let inc := fpRoundIncrement sign rm ((quot &&& 1) != 0) roundBit stickyBit let qRounded := if inc then quot + 1 else quot let (qFinal, ulpExp2Final) : Nat × Int := if qRounded ≥ (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits + 1)) then (qRounded >>> 1, ulpExp2 + 1) else (qRounded, ulpExp2) if ulpExp2Final > fmt.maxExp2 then let val := match rm with | .RNE | .RNA => fmt.packInf sign | .RTZ => fmt.packMaxFinite sign | .RTP => if sign then fmt.packMaxFinite true else fmt.packInf false | .RTN => if sign then fmt.packInf true else fmt.packMaxFinite false (val, fpsrOFC ||| fpsrIXC) else let flags : BitVec 32 := (if isTiny && inexact then fpsrUFC else 0#32) ||| (if inexact then fpsrIXC else 0#32) if qFinal < (1 <<< fmt.fracBits) then (fmt.packNat sign 0 qFinal, flags) else let biasedExp := (ulpExp2Final - fmt.minExp2 + 1).toNat let frac := qFinal - (1 <<< fmt.fracBits) (fmt.packNat sign biasedExp frac, flags)

def addFiniteDyadicL247–275 ↗#

Add two finite non-zero dyadic numbers (-1)^signA * sigA * 2^expA and (-1)^signB * sigB * 2^expB and round to fmt under rm, returning (packedValue, fpsrFlags).

def addFiniteDyadic (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (signA : Bool) (sigA : Nat) (expA : Int) (signB : Bool) (sigB : Nat) (expB : Int) : Nat × BitVec 32 := let (s1, m1, e1, s2, m2, e2) := if expA ≥ expB then (signA, sigA, expA, signB, sigB, expB) else (signB, sigB, expB, signA, sigA, expA) let diff : Nat := (e1 - e2).toNat let maxShift : Nat := 2 * fmt.fracBits + 6 let (m1Aligned, m2Aligned, expAligned, sticky) : Nat × Nat × Int × Bool := if diff ≤ maxShift then (m1 <<< diff, m2, e2, false) else let rshift := diff - maxShift let m2Shifted := if rshift > 256 then 0 else m2 >>> rshift let st := if rshift > 256 then (m2 != 0) else (m2 &&& ((1 <<< rshift) - 1)) != 0 (m1 <<< maxShift, m2Shifted, e1 - Int.ofNat maxShift, st) if s1 == s2 then roundDyadic fmt rm s1 (m1Aligned + m2Aligned) expAligned sticky else if !sticky then if m1Aligned == m2Aligned then (fmt.packZero (rm == .RTN), 0#32) else if m1Aligned > m2Aligned then roundDyadic fmt rm s1 (m1Aligned - m2Aligned) expAligned false else roundDyadic fmt rm s2 (m2Aligned - m1Aligned) expAligned false else roundDyadic fmt rm s1 (m1Aligned - m2Aligned - 1) expAligned true

def natSqrtBitsL277–282 ↗#

Exact integer floor square root helper testing bits from k - 1 down to 0.

def natSqrtBits (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat | 0, acc => acc | k + 1, acc => let cand := acc + (1 <<< k) if cand * cand ≤ n then natSqrtBits n k cand else natSqrtBits n k acc

def natSqrtL284–286 ↗#

Exact integer floor square root ⌊√n⌋.

def natSqrt (n : Nat) : Nat := if n == 0 then 0 else natSqrtBits n ((Nat.log2 n) / 2 + 1) 0

Format-Generic Operations

def fpAbsL290–292 ↗#

Format-generic floating-point absolute value (FABS).

def fpAbs (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width := x &&& BitVec.ofNat fmt.width ((1 <<< (fmt.expBits + fmt.fracBits)) - 1)

def fpNegL294–296 ↗#

Format-generic floating-point negation (FNEG).

def fpNeg (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width := x ^^^ BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (1 <<< (fmt.expBits + fmt.fracBits))

def fpIsNaNL298–300 ↗#

Format-generic NaN test (|x| > +Inf).

def fpIsNaN (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := fpAbs fmt x > BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.maxExp <<< fmt.fracBits)

def fpIsSignalingNaNL302–304 ↗#

Format-generic signaling NaN test.

def fpIsSignalingNaN (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := fpIsNaN fmt x && (x &&& BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits - 1))) == 0#(fmt.width)

def fpIsInfL306–308 ↗#

Format-generic ±Inf test.

def fpIsInf (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := fpAbs fmt x == BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.maxExp <<< fmt.fracBits)

def fpIsZeroL310–312 ↗#

Format-generic ±0.0 test.

def fpIsZero (fmt : FpFormat) (x : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := fpAbs fmt x == 0#(fmt.width)

def fpEqL314–316 ↗#

Format-generic ordered IEEE-754 equality (false if either is NaN; +0.0 == -0.0).

def fpEq (fmt : FpFormat) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := !fpIsNaN fmt a && !fpIsNaN fmt b && ((fpIsZero fmt a && fpIsZero fmt b) || a == b)

def fpLtL318–323 ↗#

Format-generic ordered IEEE-754 strict less-than (false if either is NaN).

def fpLt (fmt : FpFormat) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : Bool := !fpIsNaN fmt a && !fpIsNaN fmt b && !(fpIsZero fmt a && fpIsZero fmt b) && (if a.msb != b.msb then a.msb else if a.msb then fpAbs fmt b < fpAbs fmt a else fpAbs fmt a < fpAbs fmt b)

def fpAddL325–344 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 addition (FADD) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpAdd (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := match processNaNs2 fmt a b with | some res => res | none => match fmt.unpackFp a, fmt.unpackFp b with | .inf sA, .inf sB => if sA == sB then (a, 0#32) else (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width fmt.defaultNaN, fpsrIOC) | .inf _, _ => (a, 0#32) | _, .inf _ => (b, 0#32) | .zero sA, .zero sB => let sOut := if sA == sB then sA else (rm == .RTN) (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packZero sOut), 0#32) | _, .zero _ => (a, 0#32) | .zero _, _ => (b, 0#32) | .finite sA sigA expA, .finite sB sigB expB => let (raw, flags) := addFiniteDyadic fmt rm sA sigA expA sB sigB expB (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width raw, flags) | _, _ => (0#(fmt.width), 0#32)

def fpSubL346–351 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 subtraction (FSUB) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpSub (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := match processNaNs2 fmt a b with | some res => res | none => fpAdd fmt rm a (fpNeg fmt b)

def fpMulL353–370 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 multiplication (FMUL) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpMul (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := match processNaNs2 fmt a b with | some res => res | none => let signOut := a.msb != b.msb match fmt.unpackFp a, fmt.unpackFp b with | .inf _, .zero _ | .zero _, .inf _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width fmt.defaultNaN, fpsrIOC) | .inf _, _ | _, .inf _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packInf signOut), 0#32) | .zero _, _ | _, .zero _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packZero signOut), 0#32) | .finite _ sigA expA, .finite _ sigB expB => let (raw, flags) := roundDyadic fmt rm signOut (sigA * sigB) (expA + expB) false (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width raw, flags) | _, _ => (0#(fmt.width), 0#32)

def fpNMulL372–376 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 negated multiplication (FNMUL) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpNMul (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := let res := fpMul fmt rm a b (fpNeg fmt res.1, res.2)

def fpDivL378–399 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 division (FDIV) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpDiv (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a b : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := match processNaNs2 fmt a b with | some res => res | none => let signOut := a.msb != b.msb match fmt.unpackFp a, fmt.unpackFp b with | .inf _, .inf _ | .zero _, .zero _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width fmt.defaultNaN, fpsrIOC) | .inf _, _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packInf signOut), 0#32) | _, .zero _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packInf signOut), fpsrDZC) | .zero _, _ | _, .inf _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (fmt.packZero signOut), 0#32) | .finite _ sigA expA, .finite _ sigB expB => let shift : Nat := 2 * fmt.fracBits + 4 let num : Nat := sigA <<< shift let (raw, flags) := roundDyadic fmt rm signOut (num / sigB) (expA - expB - Int.ofNat shift) (num % sigB != 0) (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width raw, flags) | _, _ => (0#(fmt.width), 0#32)

def fpSqrtL401–417 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 square root (FSQRT) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpSqrt (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := match fmt.unpackFp a with | .nan true => (a ||| BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits - 1)), fpsrIOC) | .nan false | .zero _ | .inf false => (a, 0#32) | .inf true | .finite true _ _ => (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width fmt.defaultNaN, fpsrIOC) | .finite false sig exp2 => let bits := Nat.log2 sig + 1 let minRadBits := 2 * (fmt.fracBits + 3) + 2 let baseShift := if bits < minRadBits then minRadBits - bits else 0 let shift := if (exp2 - Int.ofNat baseShift) % 2 == 0 then baseShift else baseShift + 1 let radicand := sig <<< shift let expEven := exp2 - Int.ofNat shift let q := natSqrt radicand let (raw, flags) := roundDyadic fmt rm false q (expEven / 2) (radicand - q * q != 0) (BitVec.ofNat fmt.width raw, flags)

def fpRintValL419–431 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 round-to-integral value (FRINT*).

def fpRintVal (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (a : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width := match fmt.unpackFp a with | .nan true => a ||| BitVec.ofNat fmt.width (1 <<< (fmt.fracBits - 1)) | .nan false | .zero _ | .inf _ => a | .finite sign sig exp2 => if exp2 ≥ 0 then a else let (quot, roundBit, stickyBit) := rshiftWithRoundSticky (fmt.fracBits + 2) sig (-exp2).toNat false let inc := fpRoundIncrement sign rm ((quot &&& 1) != 0) roundBit stickyBit let intMag := if inc then quot + 1 else quot let raw := if intMag == 0 then fmt.packZero sign else (roundDyadic fmt .RNE sign intMag 0 false).1 BitVec.ofNat fmt.width raw

def fpRintFlagsL433–442 ↗#

Format-generic FPSR exception flags for FRINT* (IOC on sNaN; IXC when exact and non-integral).

def fpRintFlags (fmt : FpFormat) (exact : Bool) (a : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec 32 := match fmt.unpackFp a with | .nan true => fpsrIOC | .nan false | .zero _ | .inf _ => 0#32 | .finite _ sig exp2 => if !exact || exp2 ≥ 0 then 0#32 else let (_, roundBit, stickyBit) := rshiftWithRoundSticky (fmt.fracBits + 2) sig (-exp2).toNat false if roundBit || stickyBit then fpsrIXC else 0#32

def fpRintL444–447 ↗#

Format-generic IEEE-754 round-to-integral (FRINT*) returning (result, fpsrFlags).

def fpRint (fmt : FpFormat) (rm : FpRoundMode) (exact : Bool) (a : BitVec fmt.width) : BitVec fmt.width × BitVec 32 := (fpRintVal fmt rm a, fpRintFlags fmt exact a)
